v1.feedback: The 'lemon-zest' surprise is cleanly executed: a differential-growth ribbon rises vertically with recognizable helical form, then balloons into glossy citrus-yellow Koons inflations every 7.5s before deflating—the linked idea unmistakably drives the design. The palette swerve (gold→lemon→lime) and metalness pulse are restrained and tasteful. Minor improvements: the ribbon tube could use slightly more radial segments for smoother balloon bulges at peak inflation, and the camera could start closer (currently the form occupies ~8% of frame early on, just under the 10% threshold).
